sourceDistinctions: Water Sense is a Survival check for potable water within 100 ft. The DC is based on depth, and the player entry gives no action or retry limit.
Sure Feet changes the terrain cost of shallow and deep sand. Glare Resistance addresses dazzling from bright sunlight.
The separate Warrior is at p. 141. Named prestige-class NPCs on pp. 74–76 use individual statistics.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Sandstorm errata file. The official FAQ has no Bhuka entry.
portraitForm: Akari of the Reed Well, an original Bhuka Druid
